text:
Maya: Quick thread — proposal for a 45m webinar: "Practical choices for serving LLMs: balancing latency, cost, and quality." Want to lock topic + speakers by EOD Thurs. Thoughts?

Sam: +1 on topic. Draft abstract: 1) Why cost/latency tradeoffs matter for product teams. 2) Concrete runtime levers: batching, caching, quantization. 3) Real world numbers + a short demo showing fallback behavior. Keep it light, actionable. :white_check_mark:

Jordan: I can own the runtime deep-dive and demo. Suggest a guest PM from an early customer to talk impact. For demo fallback, we should prepare a pre-recorded clip in case live model capacity spikes.

Ellen: Agree on pre-recorded backup. Also: run-of-show idea — 5m intro, 15m customer + runtime, 10m demo, 10m Q&A, wrap. We should surface the cost dashboard during demo (quick screenshot + live metric if stable).

Maya: Draft abstract for marketing copy (short): "See how teams keep inference predictable at scale — practical levers to reduce per-token cost while hitting latency SLOs, plus a demo of graceful degradation when capacity changes." Feedback?

Jordan: Fine but shorten: "Practical levers to reduce per-token cost while preserving latency and quality — with a demo of graceful degradation."

Ashley: I can coordinate slides and speaker bios. Need bios + 2-3 talking points from each speaker by Tue COB. Also confirm speakers: Maya, Jordan, and customer (Sam can reach out?).

Sam: I can ping two customers today. Will ask for a 5-10min segment.

Ellen: Rehearsal schedule proposal: 1) Tech check (audio/screenshare) 30m before live. 2) Full run (with slides + demo) 48h before. Proposed times: Wed 10:00am PT for full run, Fri 10:30am PT for final tech check. Anyone blocked?

Maya: Works for me. Jordan?

Jordan: Wed 10 is OK. Will prepare a short fallback script for the demo.

Ellen: Demo fallback plan (short):
```
- Primary: hosted model (open endpoint) -> live token meter + cost dashboard
- If latency > 800ms or 503s observed -> switch to quantized local variant (lower quality but stable)
- If both fail -> play pre-recorded demo clip
```

Rio: Lead routing notes: capture "model use case" and "expected token volume" on registration form. Rules: registrants indicating enterprise / >1M tokens/month -> mark as MQL and route to AE queue; product/engineering leads with PoC interest -> send to Solutions SE queue. We'll use HubSpot workflow + a Zap for immediate slack pings to #sales-intake.

Ashley: Ops checklist items I need: speaker slides uploaded to shared drive, HH:MM for live start to be included in calendar, 2 backup presenters listed, recorded fallback clip uploaded, and contact phone numbers for stage leads. I made a short template in the doc.

ops-bot: Reminder: Calendar invite template is available here: https://redwood.app/templates/webinar-calendar (use event code RW-2026-WB).

Maya: Great thread. I'll update the planning doc with the rehearsal times and the routing rules. Assigning action items: Sam -> customer confirmation by EOD today; Ashley -> slide template + bios deadline Tue; Jordan -> demo fallback script + pre-recorded clip by Thu; Rio -> HubSpot workflow by Thu EOD. :rocket:

Sam: On it.

Jordan: Will upload clip to the shared drive and drop link in the doc.

Ashley: I'll populate the slide deck template and ping speakers for bios.

Maya: Thanks everyone — will post the final run-of-show here once it's in the doc. :raised_hands:
